news.title: "Is US sure it wants to turn back clock?" Iran FM's jibe at Trump's 'Stone Age' remark
news.description: Iranian leaders have strongly criticized Donald Trump's threats to devastate Iran. Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi questioned the logic of such actions. President Masoud Pezeshkian highlighted Iran's peaceful history and condemned attacks on medical facilities. Parliament Speaker MB Ghalibaf suggested financial motives behind the policy. These statements come amid rising global concerns over energy security.
news.why: You may pay more for fuel if global tensions escalate.

news.title: Treasuries Fall After March Jobs Data Reduces Bets on Fed Rate Cut
news.description: Bond traders ended the week betting that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates steady this year, on signs of a stabilizing US labor market and uncertainty about the economic impact of war in the Middle East.
news.why: Your mortgage and credit card interest rates will likely stay high.

news.title: Govt imposes import curbs on all articles of gold, silver, platinum
news.description: NEW DELHI, Apr 2: The Government today imposed import curbs on all forms of articles of gold, silver and platinum, a move aimed at checking misuse of free trade agreements (FTAs). These restrictions will apply irrespective of any prior contract, irrevocable letter of credit, advance payment, shipment status, or any other commitment, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) said in a notification. news.why: You will likely pay more for jewelry and precious metal gifts.

news.title: Fact check: How can a country actually withdraw from NATO?
news.description: Donald Trump has threatened to pull out of the North Atlantic alliance over European countries' reticence to join the war in Iran. However, questions remain over how exactly he would be able to do so, both under domestic law and NATO treaties.
news.why: Changes to military alliances could impact your safety and tax rates.

news.title: Akhilesh Yadav Criticizes BJP, Urges Return to Ballot Voting
news.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav criticized the BJP for blaming domestic problems on foreign conflicts such as the Iran-Israel clash. He addressed industrial concerns in Kanpur, farmer issues, and advocated for returning to ballot voting. Yadav also discussed student politics and India's foreign policy stance.
news.why: The way you cast and track your vote may soon change.

news.title: Public Policy Limits Explained
news.description: Supreme Court says foreign arbitral awards cannot be re-examined on merits at enforcement stage; clarifies narrow scope of public policy exception under Indian law.
news.why: New policy limits could reduce the government services you receive.

news.why: Your public comments could lead to legal or travel complications.

news.title: United Raises Bag Fees, Following JetBlue’s Lead as Fuel Costs Soar
news.description: As the war in Iran strains U.S. airlines, JetBlue and United are now charging up to $10 more for checked bags on domestic flights. More carriers could follow.
news.why: Your next vacation will be more expensive if you check bags.

news.why: New medical tests could help identify and treat your child’s illness.

news.title: U.S. Lifts Sanctions on Noted Russian Banker Mikhail Zadornov
news.description: The U.S. has lifted sanctions against Mikhail Zadornov, a prominent Russian banker and former finance minister. Despite the delisting, there is no broader shift in U.S. policy towards Russian sanctions. Zadornov's removal results from a successful petition to the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control.
news.why: Lifting sanctions could eventually reduce the cost of your imported goods.

news.title: Trump’s Iran war has woken Albanese up to a new reality. Will it spur him towards ‘ambitious’ reforms?
news.description: The global energy shock and Trump’s ‘flip-flopping’ objectives could accelerate the PM’s pursuit of the kind of longer-term changes he has shied away from in the past
news.why: Major political reforms could change your local job market and taxes.

news.title: NCSC warns of messaging app targeting by Russia-linked actors
news.description: The UK National Cyber Security Centre has warned of increasing attempts by Russia-based actors to target individuals via messaging apps, including WhatsApp, Signal and Messenger.
news.why: Your private messages and personal photos may be at risk.
